requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with Increased Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new generation bottles with keying features for 6K Black, 6K CMY page yield, and ensure CMY bottle size supports >8K pages.
requirements.Rationale: Higher yield bottles reduce customer intervention and improve cost-per-page competitiveness.
requirements.Dependencies: Bottle design, ink compatibility, printer firmware support
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bottles must pass keying validation, support >8K CMY, and deliver specified page yields in standard test conditions.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Bottle Reliability
requirements.Description: The bottle and refill system must ensure spill-free operation during installation and use.
requirements.Rationale: Spill-free refilling is critical for user satisfaction and to reduce mess/complaints.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Refill process must pass HP internal spill test procedures with zero ink spillage observed.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Implement NOA-F design with a metal foiled labyrinth and a lid label; no changes to click-on push-push and TDF.
requirements.Rationale: Enhanced NOA-F design for reliability and differentiation, while maintaining existing user interactions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F part must meet HP reliability standards and pass design reviews; user operation remains unchanged.

requirements.Title: Reuse SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Ink
requirements.Description: Leverage existing SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie pigment inks without reformulation.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces R&D effort, leverages proven technology, and ensures supply chain continuity.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with new platform and bottle design
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No ink reformulation required; performance verified in new product context.

requirements.Title: Ink System Reliability and Characterization
requirements.Description: Model and validate reliability, WVTR (Water Vapor Transmission Rate), air gain, flow rate, IDS, including startup and NOA-F end-of-life.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures robust ink delivery and long-term reliability for the new system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All models and tests must meet HP reliability criteria over expected product life.

requirements.Title: Support Services and Warranty Parts
requirements.Description: NOA-F must be available as a service part during warranty; support for services/contractual obligations.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures field serviceability and contractual compliance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F listed as a service part and available within warranty timeframes.

requirements.Title: Factory Line Modifications for NOA-F and Ink Cart
requirements.Description: Modify existing SA14 line for NOA-F, add Magi ink cart and labeling tool in Orcus 5; support assembly of PHA, Dry FI, USG, push-push in printer factory.
requirements.Rationale: Enables production of new product variants with minimal investment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Factory lines modified and validated for new product builds before launch.

requirements.Title: Support Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design system so that customers can replace PHA and NOA-F themselves.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces service costs and downtime, aligns with customer self-service trends.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Customer can replace PHA and NOA-F using standard tools and instructions; process validated by usability testing.

requirements.Title: Warranty Page Life Goal of 80k Pages
requirements.Description: Set and support a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Increases competitive positioning for high-use environments and reduces TCO.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product must reliably print 80,000 pages without major service under standard use conditions.

requirements.Title: SKU 2 (Hi + Hi PDL) PaaS Enablement
requirements.Description: Enable SKU 2 with high throughput and PDL (Page Description Language) for PaaS (Print as a Service) business models.
requirements.Rationale: Supports flexible business models and meets enterprise/SMB needs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SKU 2 available for PaaS, with high throughput and PDL support validated.

requirements.Title: Reddington ID with Increased Tank Size
requirements.Description: Adopt Reddington ID with an increased tank size; no change to Marconi-HI ADF.
requirements.Rationale: Accommodates higher yield bottles and aligns with product family design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Tank size increased and validated for new bottle compatibility; ID matches Reddington.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Compliance
requirements.Description: Ensure product meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel requirements for environmental standards (PDL SKU).
requirements.Rationale: Mandatory for regulatory compliance and market access.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes certification for EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel before launch.

requirements.Title: Input/Output Tray Changes for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Redesign input and output trays to accommodate increased tank protrusion and optimize size.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures proper paper handling and maintains compact footprint.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays fit with new tank size; paper handling performance unchanged or improved.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch CGD (Color Graphic Display) for user interface.
requirements.Rationale: Improves user experience and aligns with modern UI expectations.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product includes 4.3” CGD and passes usability testing.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Update service station for improved aerosol management due to tank changes.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents contamination and ensures print quality.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol containment validated in lab and field tests.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model Update
requirements.Description: Update carriage dynamics and force models to account for new tube routing and increased component weights.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliable printhead movement and system durability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage system passes HP reliability and performance tests with new configuration.

requirements.Title: Paper Path Upgrade for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Upgrade paper path to support increased page life (80k pages).
requirements.Rationale: Reduces wear and maintains print quality over extended use.
requirements.Dependencies: Paper path component selection, reliability testing
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path components meet durability targets in accelerated life testing.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance as Serviceable Part
requirements.Description: Make ink maintenance a serviceable part at service centers, especially post 80k page life.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability and extends product life.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink maintenance part available and replaceable at service centers post 80k pages.

requirements.Title: New IDS Make-Break and FI Connection
requirements.Description: Implement new IDS make-break and fluidic interconnect (FI) connection, leveraging LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI SHAID.
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability and security of ink delivery system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: IDS connection passes reliability and security validation.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop new IDS startup algorithm and air management system.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent print quality and reliable startup.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup and air management validated in field and lab tests.

requirements.Title: New PQ Goals and Depletion Definition
requirements.Description: Set new print quality (PQ) goals and deplete-to-empty definition to align with page yield targets.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures customer expectations are met for print quality and yield.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PQ and depletion metrics defined and validated in test prints.

requirements.Title: Reuse of Marconi Hi PDL and Tux dASIC
requirements.Description: Reuse Marconi Hi PDL, Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU in new platform.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development cost and leverages proven components.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Components function as required in new product context.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module and Dune Firmware
requirements.Description: Integrate Stingray Wi-Fi module and Dune firmware for wireless connectivity.
requirements.Rationale: Meets modern connectivity expectations and supports HP ecosystem.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Wireless connectivity passes HP standard performance and security tests.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security (HW & FW)
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx hardware and firmware security features.
requirements.Rationale: Protects against modern security threats and meets enterprise requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Security features validated against HP security standards.

requirements.Title: Support for Multiple Business Models and Solutions
requirements.Description: Enable support for Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise business models, including PaaS, WorkFromHome/Flexworker, onboarding/S&O paths, scan solutions, SMB manageability, and Enterprise support (WJA, HPSM, JAM).
requirements.Rationale: Expands market reach and meets diverse customer needs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed business models and solutions supported and validated in launch readiness review.

requirements.Title: Clients & Drivers Compatibility
requirements.Description: Ensure compatibility with HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD clients and drivers.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures seamless deployment and management in various environments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All clients and drivers validated on supported platforms.

requirements.Title: Speed: 25/20ppm (PDL: 25/19ppm)
requirements.Description: Achieve print speeds of 25/20 ppm (pages per minute), and 25/19 ppm for PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Meets market expectations for performance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Print speed validated in standard HP performance tests.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K Pages
requirements.Description: Ensure SuperAmp PHA supports a minimum life of 65,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Critical for reliability and cost of ownership.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA passes life testing for 65,000 pages.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life: 2 Years or Page Limit
requirements.Description: Provide a warranty of 2 years or up to defined page life, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with market standards and customer expectations.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms published and supported in all launch regions.

requirements.Title: Serviceability: Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Include a maintenance box as a serviceable component to improve serviceability.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and simplifies maintenance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box is field-replaceable and validated in service tests.

requirements.Title: Host 12K-CMYK and Trade Page 6K
requirements.Description: Support host-based 12K-CMYK and trade page 6K options as flexible priorities.
requirements.Rationale: Provides options for different markets and customer segments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Host 12K-CMYK and trade 6K SKUs available for order and validated.
